remarks: Welcome to 12 Kona Rd-Where Elegance Meets Modern Sophistication. Nestled on over an acre at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this stunning 5 bedroom,6.5 bath colonial offers the perfect blend of privacy, tranquility & convenience in one of Darien's most coveted neighborhoods. With 6,805 sq. ft of beautifully updated living space, this home is just minutes from town, trains & top-rated schools. Step inside & be captivated by the entryway, which flows seamlessly into a bright & inviting formal living room with a gas fireplace & custom built-ins. To one side, a study with a gas fireplace, bar, & kegerator and wine/beverage fridge invites relaxation, while the elegant formal dining is perfect for entertaining. At the heart of the home, a state-of-the art chef's kitchen, featuring sleek white cabinetry, Danby marble countertops, Subzero/Wolf appliances, PUR20 water filtration system, plus a sunlit breakfast area. Step into a breathtaking great room, where 16 ft ceilings, soaring windows, a fireplace,& built-ins create an airy, dramatic space filled with natural light. Upstairs, a peaceful primary suite boasts vaulted ceilings, dual walk-in closets,& luxurious en-suite bath. Four additional bedrooms, three full baths & a sitting area complete the upper level. Above two-car garage, a spacious bonus room, bath & studio offer endless possibilities. Lower level features playroom, office, bath & mudroom-designed for comfort & functionality.
